milestones.title: Natural terrain spike
milestones.completion: Seam-free editable/collidable low-poly 3x3 terrain patch proof.

evidence.surface_contract: pc3d_render::surface (new): 3x3 isolated region — each 16 m patch a 17x17 vertex boundary grid with SEAM-SHARED boundaries (patch p's east column IS p+1's west column by construction; test asserts identical vertices on all internal east+south seams); base heights + materials sampled from the AUTHORITATIVE generator (effective_surface_mm / final_solid); sparse signed-delta edit layer; low-poly mesh = 2 triangles per cell on the fixed NW-SE diagonal with flat facet normals and per-cell authoritative material colors
evidence.collision_from_same_data: height_at (bilinear over the same grid) is proven within every facet's min/max at 64 sampled points; walkability = 3x3-node-stencil max-rise/step <= 1.6 (the stencil sees neighbor nodes — a lowered cell drops all its OWN corners, so the wall only exists against adjacent nodes; the first cell-only stencil missed it and the cliff test caught it)
evidence.edits: SurfaceEdit Raise/Lower/Level as commands over 1 m cells (corner-node deltas); an INTERIOR edit dirties exactly ONE patch, a border edit dirties patch+neighbor (asserted incl. diagonals); Level sets an absolute target; the version table proves remesh is BOUNDED to dirty patches (changed == dirty)
evidence.save_load: the sparse delta layer encodes/decodes through a compact record (only nonzero deltas), round-trips exactly, and corrupt/truncated payloads refuse with errors
evidence.windowed_proof: --play-surface / make p3d-surface: before/after captures of the spike region — a 3x3 raised plateau through the edit command path, remesh 2601 verts bounded to one dirty patch, image diff visible; BEFORE capture human-inspected PASS: smooth rolling FACETED natural hills (visibly sloped, continuous shading — NOT staircase cubes)
evidence.cube_vs_surface_discriminator: the GPU test's semantic checks: >=3 luminance bands along the downhill run (a flat plane = 1); adjacent-row delta distribution — a continuous slope shades on most ground rows with <=4 hard jumps (a cube staircase bands identical flats + wall jumps), ground rows identified by control-difference render; edit visibility by image diff
evidence.bug_caught_by_proof: the first mesh wound triangles CLOCKWISE seen from above — backface culling ate the entire terrain and the pixel dump showed pure sky; fixed to CCW (the same class of bug the root project's face-winding history warns about)
evidence.gates: existing 9-gate battery re-run green after the change; old cube path untouched (construction unchanged); spike is isolated until NWR-004

milestones.title: Sparse caves, water and foundations
milestones.completion: Seam-safe cave, conforming river and terrain-aware building proofs.
milestones.evidence: pc3d_render::world_features: CaveRegion (BFS connected-component from final_solid carved cells, cap 16 half-extent/8000 cells, face-net quad extraction welding to the surface via the same final_solid boundary contract, cave_stone material), ConformingWater (17-sample strips over river edges following SurfaceRegion patch heights + deltas, water_line = strip min - 0.45, width/speed from the authoritative FlowRecord, local refresh_after_edit), check_foundation (walkable + slope + LEVEL_TOL 1.5 with named rejections). GPU proof cave_water_and_foundation_render_and_edit_locally: cave interior control-diff 0.63, 127 blue-dominant conforming-water pixels, 1/5 sections changed by a strip edit (exactly the refreshed section), foundation Valid at +4 m. Windowed make p3d-caves (--play-caves): cave-interior capture (no daylight leak, human-inspected), river before/after a 2x2 raise dam (image diff ~1%), LOCAL EDIT 1/5 sections refresh 9 us + water remesh 6 us, frames p50 0.43 ms. Unit laws: cave volume welds + walks the boundary without seams, water locality (an edit reaches only nearby sections), foundations accept level ground and reject steep/unlevel with reasons, player walks the surface and feels edits through CollisionSurface. Real bug the proofs caught: a SurfaceRegion is a 48 m 3x3-PATCH window, not a 3x3-region window; build wrote 0.0 for missing patches while refresh used the generator fallback, letting fake height changes hide behind the mismatch - both now use the generator fallback and the edit window sits on the strip itself.

milestones.title: Materials and atmosphere
milestones.completion: Tiered stylized materials, lighting, shadows, fog and water validated.
milestones.evidence: pc3d_render::atmosphere (new): AtmosphereTier Low/Mid/High with documented budgets (Low: no shadow pass, fog 0.0040; Mid 1024^2 depth +~4MB: fog 0.0055, detail 0.55, glint; High 2048^2 +~16MB: fog 0.0070, detail 0.85); LEGACY default (every term identity) keeps all pre-NWR-006 proofs bit-identical until a tier is applied. Stable sun shadow map: depth-only pass (vs_shadow + cutout variant), ortho box TEXEL-SNAPPED in light space (sub-texel motion leaves the matrix bit-fixed, unit-asserted), 3x3 PCF with constant + slope-scaled shader bias and normal offset, soft 0.35 floor. exp2 distance fog mixed in linear space (CPU mirror fog_factor/apply_flog is the probe truth). Material detail: 4-tile procedural atlas (grass/rock RIDGED/sand/snow sparkle) generated from pc3d_assets::material_detail + DETAIL_ATLAS_SPECS metadata, blended by albedo-derived material weights (WGSL mirror of material_weights; no vertex format change); the legacy detail flag now reads atlas tile 0. Water sun glint (view-dependent lobe, capped 0.8). Alpha-cutout foliage: vs_cutout/fs_cutout discard pipeline (mask at group 1), foliage_quads crossed leaf cards + deterministic leaf_mask with nibbled holes, Solid control mask. GPU proofs (13 atmosphere tests): shadow strongest darkening 0.35 mean-delta 0.004 local + sun-side unchanged + still-camera bit-identical stability; fog far-field pulled to haze (0.70 -> 0.07 distance-to-haze) with near ground kept; material grain grass 2->81 / rock 2->108 distinct colors with separation and hues preserved; glint brightest water pixel 2.36 -> 2.84; cutout wall pixels through leaf 3485 vs solid 3361 (+holes) with 2.4% frame diff; tier rows render with the tier's shadow budget and timing. Windowed --play-materials / make p3d-materials (171 frames p50 0.70-0.84 ms): mid/legacy/high/cutout captures human-inspected PASS (cast shadows behind foliage, haze at the horizon, sun glint streak on the water, mottled grass vs rock, leaf cards with visible-through holes), atmosphere diffs 34%/39% vs legacy. 9/9 visual gates green (LEGACY default). Real bugs the proofs caught: the RH ortho depth row assumed +z forward; SUN_DIR points TOWARD the sun so the light camera must look along -SUN_DIR; the shadow-map lookup v coordinate must flip vs NDC y (everything-shadowed run); wgpu float-depth pipeline bias units are whole-range (constant 2 lit everything); the shadow pass must not sample the texture it writes (usage-scope law -> bg_light).

milestones.title: Wilderness assets
milestones.completion: Original instanced biome asset set with LOD, collision and performance proof.
milestones.evidence: pc3d_world::flora (new, PURE): PlantKind x9 + PlantKind::blocks_movement/wind/name, plant_at on a 4 m slot grid (FNV hash gated by a per-biome density table; trees reserve the even-diagonal subgrid = 8 m spacing and refuse slopes > 0.9; Ocean grows nothing), landmark_at (~18% hash gate, land biomes, gentle ground search), jitter (render variation from the authority). Tests: determinism + seed variation, tree spacing subgrid, biome character over searched regions (Forest 446 trees vs Plains 43; Plains grassland; Mountains rocky/no grass; Ocean empty), collision contract, landmark determinism+rarity (44/256 regions). assetgen: nine new original GLBs (tree_pine conical 238 tris, tree_broadleaf billow 368, tree_birch pale slender 396, rock_boulder 128, rock_spire 102, rock_slab 72, shrub 192, log_fallen 246, landmark standing_stone 125) — byte-identical regen within budgets; wilderness_batch.json pack (9 integrated rows, flora/landmark categories added to schema v2) validates against files on disk. pc3d_render::flora: FloraStreamer with ONE DRAW PER (KIND, LOD) bucket (17 buckets, ~830 instances in the proof), LOD by the glb thresholds, grass as wind-animated cutout cards within its own radius, BOUNDED placement (rotating ring-phase scan, cached negatives, 3072 new-slot budget/call), eviction beyond ring+16 (teleport/reload proven: same ring returns, cache converges), instances cast sun shadows; FloraGround collision adapter derives solidity from the AUTHORITY (the walk test stops at a trunk and passes clear ground — no ghosting by construction). GPU proof: control-diff 0.25 with atmosphere Mid, wind frame-diff 0.0077 between two frozen times, 17 LOD buckets, 836 instances. Windowed --play-wilderness / make p3d-wilderness (191 frames p50 3.88 ms / avg 333 fps WITH atmosphere + 830 instances): control/vista/landmark/low-tier captures human-inspected PASS (evergreens + shrubs + distant treeline under haze in the vista; the standing stone monolith with plinth + flank stones + swaying foreground grass), 3% pixel diff vs the no-flora control. 9/9 gates green. Bugs the proofs caught: the scan restart-at-ring-0 meant big view radii never reached outer rings under the per-frame budget (the settle test caught it; rings now rotate by phase), and empty slots were re-queried every call until negatives were cached.

milestones.evidence: pc3d_render::npcs grew the RIG (NWR-009): an original low-poly limb-based NPC (legs 0-0.75, torso 0.75-1.35 + arms, head to 1.7) with role variants — guard (steel helm + spear, always readable), worker (wood cap + tool ONLY while Working — an idle worker never looks busy), resident (satchel) — and a DETERMINISTIC animation state machine rig_pose(brain, t): pure f(intent, t); Walking swings counterphase legs/arms and YAW FACES THE PATH LEG (from the sim path, never a visual guess); work activities stroke the right arm; Sleeping is a low lying silhouette; Idle breathes. Impostors beyond 64 m: one torso-colored box (the reduced-detail far policy). Drawing: a new inst_box pipeline (unit cube + PER-AXIS instance scale) with one bucket per part COLOR — a crowd of any size is <= ~8 draw calls (12-NPC proof: 7 draws / 92 part instances); poses rebuild per frame in prepare_frame from the shared clock (frozen-able — deterministic proofs). Positions always npc_world_pos(brain) — no visual simulation. attach_crowd stores the gen/cast/nav; crowd_tick advances the AUTHORITATIVE brains; crowd_stage_walkers stages presentation-copy walkers in the sim's own Walking state for camera-facing proofs (labeled as such). CrowdGround capsule adapter: NPC cells block the player chest-high. Proofs: 4 rig tests — pose determinism + intent laws (walking yaw/faces travel + counterphase legs at sin peak; work stroke animates and the tool is activity-gated; guard steel at every activity; sleeping body under 0.6 m; impostor = 1 box); crowd_instances follow the sim positions and bucket by color (<= 8); the capsule stops a walk; GPU — characters render (control-diff 0.0725), 7 draws / 23 instances, the rig ANIMATES between frozen times (0.0112). Windowed --play-people / make p3d-people (151 frames p50 5.9-6.0 ms with atmosphere + flora + kit + crowd; 12-NPC crowd 7 draws): plaza/stride/guard/anchors captures human-inspected PASS — limbed people with role gear in the lane, the full guard rig (helm, spear) close-up, the anchor frames visible; stride frames differ 0.35%. The existing npc-cast gate (the mesh path) stayed green untouched. 9/9 gates; p3d 418/418, root 474/474.

milestones.title: Steam Deck quality contract
milestones.completion: Reproducible low/medium/high benchmark and quality proof.
milestones.evidence: pc3d_render::deck (new): the TRANSPARENT Low/Mid/High contract composing every tier lever (streaming rings/mesh-work/GPU budget from QualityTier; atmosphere shadow/fog/detail/glint; flora + grass radii; the NEW crowd pose-rate lever — Low 15 Hz, quantized so frozen clocks stay deterministic) plus an honest render-scale row (1.0 — no scale-swap path exists) and a world/interactions row (SAME world; anchors, characters, water, edits visible at every tier). apply() composes; report_md renders the documented report. Tests: contract completeness + monotonicity (mesh work, budgets, radii, shadow res, detail all Low<=Mid<=High), Low readability laws (characters animate >=15 Hz, wilderness >=80 m, no lever can hide interactions), report rendering. The BENCHMARK: --deck-bench <seed> <outdir> [low|mid|high|report] — one windowed run per tier over the FULL stack (streamed terrain + flora + settlement kit + 12-NPC crowd + atmosphere) walking four waypoints, collecting p50/p95/p99/worst/avg-fps + streamer counters (meshed, GPU KB) + scene-stack counters; the report pass assembles docs/POORCRAFT-VALHEIM-STYLE-REBUILD/DECK-BENCH-REPORT.md (hardware documented as the Apple host iGPU evidence machine) and enforces the LOW-NOT-SLOWER law. MEASURED (800x500): low p50 4.88 ms p95 9.95 (167 fps, 5.1 MB GPU, 176 patches meshed), mid p50 6.50 p95 7.63 (149 fps, 18.9 MB, 402), high p50 6.66 p95 8.07 (146 fps, 27.6 MB, 603) — the levers measurably behave and the caps HELD every frame. Readability captures per tier pass probes + distinct-color checks; the low capture human-inspected PASS (characters, crofts, treeline readable). Bottlenecks documented in the report: terrain patch meshing is the CPU spike source (capped and held), the crowd per-frame rebuild gates to 15 Hz at Low. One process per tier (winit allows one event loop — the first three-in-one attempt failed loudly). 9/9 gates; p3d 421/421, root 474/474.
